source: We need more spending for America's struggling schools, and national standards and testing to identify and fix poor performers. Every child deserves a strong, functional school to attend.
zh: 我们需要为美国陷入困境的学校提供​​更多支出，并需要国家标准和测试来识别和解决表现不佳的学生。每个孩子都应该就读一所实力雄厚、功能齐全的学校。

source: We need to increase pay for teachers and increase funding for the Department of Education. I don't support nationwide standards or testing -- they will distort the learning process and lead to education by rote.
zh: 我们需要增加教师工资并增加教育部的资金。我不支持全国性的标准或测试——它们会扭曲学习过程并导致死记硬背的教育。

source: The Social Security system is a financial time bomb. We need to get rid of it, or at the very least cut its benefits significantly.
zh: 社会保障系统是一个金融定时炸弹。我们需要摆脱它，或者至少大幅削减它的好处。

source: The average worker would do much better if their money was invested in the stock market. I support a plan to allow workers to contribute at least some of their Social Security contribution to an individual investment account.
zh: 如果普通工人的钱投资于股票市场，他们会做得更好。我支持一项计划，允许工人将至少部分社会保障捐款存入个人投资账户。

source: We need to increase benefits for Social Security. Many people can barely survive on the monthly payment, while we spend billions on the military and run a huge budget surplus.
zh: 我们需要增加社会保障的福利。许多人靠每月的付款勉强生存，而我们在军事上花费数十亿美元并拥有巨额预算盈余。

source: The Cold War is over. We should cut defense spending and stop operating so many bases overseas. I would pull troops out of places like Germany and Okinawa, where we are no longer defending anything.
zh: 冷战结束了。我们应该削减国防开支并停止运营如此多的海外基地。我会从德国和冲绳等地撤军，因为我们在那里不再保卫任何东西。

source: America should remain tough, but humble. I am concerned about some of our recent interventions in places like Somalia and Serbia.
zh: 美国应该保持强硬，但谦虚。我对我们最近在索马里和塞尔维亚等地采取的一些干预措施感到担忧。

source: We need to remain an engaged, committed defender of human rights in the world. We should do everything possible to secure the friendship of nations like Russia and China, and to prevent atrocities and genocide in the developing world.
zh: 我们需要继续成为世界上积极、坚定的人权捍卫者。我们应该尽一切可能确保俄罗斯和中国等国家的友谊，并防止发展中国家发生暴行和种族灭绝。

source: I would focus on removing dictators like Saddam Hussein and Kim Jong Il from power. They threaten the stability of the world and perpetrate evil upon their people.
zh: 我将专注于消除像萨达姆·侯赛因和金正日这样的独裁者。他们威胁世界的稳定并对人民施行邪恶。

source: Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
zh: 比尔·克林顿是美国的耻辱，他的弹劾是当之无愧的。我认为他应该被免职。

source: I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
zh: 我认为我们不需要详细说明这一点。我向美国人民保证，当我担任总统时，我将恢复白宫的荣誉和尊严。

source: I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
zh: 我是我自己的人。我在很多方面尊重比尔·克林顿，但在本案中缺乏他的个人行为。

source: This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
zh: 这不是问题。比尔·克林顿是过去五十年来最好的总统之一，我们应该关注他的政策和成功，而不是他的个人事务。

source: Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
zh: 将埃连送回古巴是不合理的。我不支持克林顿政府的这一决定。

source: We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
zh: 我们应该少谈论埃利安，而更多地谈论我扩大这个国家伟大繁荣的计划。

source: The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
zh: 法律就是法律。埃利安和他的父亲一起属于古巴。这些问题从来都不容易，但克林顿政府和珍妮特·雷诺做了他们必须做的事情。

source: This was an issue that had no bearing on the security of the United States. We also ruined any chance of mediation by insisting on the autonomy of Kosovo.
zh: 这是一个与美国安全无关的问题。我们还坚持科索沃自治，从而破坏了任何调解的机会。

source: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
zh: 这当然有助于推翻斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇，但作为总统，我将确保美国在干预外国事务之前谨慎行事。

source: I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
zh: 我支持我们在这个剧院的行动。我们以最小的成本阻止了潜在的种族灭绝并将独裁者绳之以法。

source: The bombing of Serbia killed many innocent civilians and increased antagonism with Russia and China. I believe military intervention should be a last resort.
zh: 对塞尔维亚的轰炸造成许多无辜平民死亡，并加剧了与俄罗斯和中国的对抗。我认为军事干预应该是最后的手段。

source: We need huge tax cuts across the board. Corporate, personal, and capital gains taxes should be slashed. This will further expand the economy through increases in investment.
zh: 我们需要全面大幅减税。公司税、个人税和资本利得税应该大幅削减。这将通过增加投资进一步扩大经济。

source: My budget will cut taxes and return a portion of our budget surplus to the American people. Everybody who pays taxes will receive a reduction.
zh: 我的预算将减税并将部分预算盈余返还给美国人民。每个纳税人都将获得减免。

source: We have a plan for middle class tax cuts. But it would be irresponsible to make huge changes while we still have a large debt.
zh: 我们有一个针对中产阶级减税的计划。但在我们仍然背负巨额债务的情况下做出巨大改变是不负责任的。

source: I have no plan to cut taxes. If anything, we might need some increases to strengthen Social Security.
zh: 我没有减税计划。如果有的话，我们可能需要一些增加来加强社会保障。

source: I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.
zh: 我支持对发动这次攻击的人做出强烈、压倒性的反应。任何窝藏此类恐怖分子的政府都应该被推翻，即使这需要美国军队的支持。

source: We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.
zh: 我们需要做两件事——首先，我们需要更好的程序来确保我们在危险地区的部队更好地保护自己。其次，我们将调查这次袭击事件的责任人，无论是基地组织还是其他组织，并对其进行相应的打击。

source: This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
zh: 这次袭击是一场悲剧，但它强调了美国需要采取更加有限的外交政策。冷战已经结束，在世界这么多地方部署军队没有任何意义。

source: A crime is a crime, no matter what the motive is. I do not support ideas that some victims should be held in higher regard than others.
zh: 犯罪就是犯罪，无论动机是什么。我不支持某些受害者应该比其他受害者受到更高尊重的想法。

source: I support increased federal hate crime legislation. No American should ever feel like a target of intimidation because of their identity.
zh: 我支持增加联邦仇恨犯罪立法。任何美国人都不应该因为自己的身份而感到自己成为恐吓的目标。

source: We have no proof that global warming exists, and we should be expanding our production of coal and oil to obtain energy independence. I would not surrender the sovereignty of our nation for such trivial objectives.
zh: 我们没有证据表明全球变暖存在，我们应该扩大煤炭和石油的生产以获得能源独立。我不会为了这些微不足道的目标而放弃我们国家的主权。

source: I would not. The Protocol exempts 80% of the world, including major population centers such as China and India, from compliance, and would cause serious harm to the US economy.
zh: 我不会。该议定书免除了世界80%的国家的遵守义务，其中包括中国和印度等主要人口中心，这将对美国经济造成严重损害。

source: It seems very unlikely that the Senate will ever come up with the votes to ratify this agreement. I don't know how my support or opposition would change that equation.
zh: 参议院似乎不太可能投票批准该协议。我不知道我的支持或反对会如何改变这个等式。

source: We have worked for years with many other countries to negotiate this agreement. I support the environment and believe the Protocol should be ratified.
zh: 我们多年来一直与许多其他国家合作谈判该协议。我支持环保并认为应该批准该议定书。

source: We have almost 9 million illegal immigrants in this country. I support stronger enforcement of immigration laws to reduce this number.
zh: 这个国家有近 900 万非法移民。我支持加强移民法的执行以减少这一数字。

source: All people contribute to a prosperous America. I support a combination of stronger immigration enforcement with a path to citizenship for people currently in the country. We can do better than we did with the 1986 law.
zh: 所有人都为繁荣的美国做出贡献。我支持将更强有力的移民执法与目前在该国的人们获得公民身份的途径结合起来。我们可以比 1986 年法律做得更好。

source: I prefer to focus on making responsible use of our budget surplus and securing prosperity for the next generation of Americans.
zh: 我更愿意专注于负责任地利用我们的预算盈余并确保下一代美国人的繁荣。

source: We need a path to citizenship for those in the country, and we need a system of work permits and strict enforcement on employers, so that immigrants do not depress American wages. We should increase aid to Latin America to reduce the rich-poor divide in our economies.
zh: 我们需要为国内的人提供一条获得公民身份的途径，我们需要一个工作许可制度和对雇主的严格执行，这样移民就不会压低美国的工资。我们应该增加对拉丁美洲的援助，以缩小经济中的贫富差距。

source: Over a million unborn children are killed every year in this country. We need judges who will overturn Roe v. Wade, or we need a Constitutional Amendment to end the practice of abortion.
zh: 这个国家每年有超过一百万未出生的婴儿被杀害。我们需要能够推翻的法官 罗诉韦德案，否则我们需要宪法修正案来结束堕胎的做法。

source: I am a pro-life candidate for President, but I understand that we have certain legal protections in place. At the very least, we can end taxpayer funding for this practice.
zh: 我是反堕胎总统候选人，但我了解我们有一定的法律保护。至少，我们可以终止纳税人对这种做法的资助。

source: My goal as President will be to reduce abortions in this country to the lowest level possible. We can increase education and funding for contraception, to reduce unwanted pregnancies. I might be open to ending late-term abortions.
zh: 作为总统，我的目标是将这个国家的堕胎率减少到尽可能低的水平。我们可以增加避孕教育和资金投入，以减少意外怀孕。我可能愿意结束晚期堕胎。

source: I strongly support the right of a woman to choose. We need to defend this right, and we should increase funding for women's health services, unconditionally.
zh: 我强烈支持女性的选择权。我们需要捍卫这一权利，我们应该无条件增加对妇女健康服务的资金投入。

source: Absolutely. Anything we can do to work towards energy independence in this country is a positive step. Oil and coal are the foundation of any energy policy, and should be exploited as much as possible.
zh: 当然。我们为实现这个国家的能源独立所做的一切都是积极的一步。石油和煤炭是任何能源政策的基础，应尽可能地加以开发。

source: This is fine with me, but it is a small part of the overall solution. We need to drill wherever we can, while encouraging innovation in other sectors of the energy market.
zh: 这对我来说没问题，但它只是整个解决方案的一小部分。我们需要尽可能地进行钻探，同时鼓励能源市场其他领域的创新。

source: I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
zh: 我反对这些计划。 ANWR是美国的环境宝藏，任何开采所获得的石油都将相对有限。

source: This is a giveaway to oil companies that will not resolve America's underlying energy issues. We need more government investment in renewable energy sources, and strict regulations on oil and coal.
zh: 这是对石油公司的赠品，无法解决美国的根本能源问题。我们需要政府对可再生能源进行更多投资，并对石油和煤炭进行严格监管。

source: Absolutely. This is just another example of meddling that harms the economy, hurts energy production, and puts hard-working Americans out of work.
zh: 当然。这只是损害经济、损害能源生产并使辛勤工作的美国人失业的干预的另一个例子。

source: Unfortunately, coal is one of the dirtiest forms of energy in existence. I don't see how we can continue to rely on it for the majority of America's energy needs.
zh: 不幸的是，煤炭是现存最肮脏的能源形式之一。我不明白我们如何继续依赖它来满足美国的大部分能源需求。

source: This is a necessary step to protect our allies in Europe from current and future threats to their security. I will strongly support this as President.
zh: 这是保护我们的欧洲盟友免受当前和未来安全威胁的必要步骤。作为总统，我将坚决支持这一点。

source: As President, I will reach out to key military leaders for their advice on this issue.
zh: 作为总统，我将向主要军事领导人寻求有关此问题的建议。

source: To defend against whom? The Cold War is over and we should be working with Russia, not against them. This is just more unnecessary military spending.
zh: 防御谁？冷战结束了，我们应该努力工作 与 俄罗斯，不反对他们。这只是更多不必要的军费开支。

source: After eight years of scandals and excesses from the Clinton Administration, I will return this country to its rightful principles -- small government, clean moral conduct, and the freedom of the people.
zh: 经过八年的克林顿政府的丑闻和暴行之后，我将使这个国家恢复其合法的原则——小政府、廉洁的道德行为和人民的自由。

source: I will ask the American people if they really want to vote for a third term of Bill Clinton, and remind them that I am the true conservative alternative. I will remind them of Al Gore's campaign finance violations and frequent misrepresentations to the American people.
zh: 我会问美国人民是否真的想投票支持比尔·克林顿的第三个任期，并提醒他们我是真正的保守派选择。我会提醒他们阿尔·戈尔的竞选财务违规行为以及对美国人民频繁的虚假陈述。

source: Conservatism doesn't mean anger and divisiveness. I will govern as a sensible, pragmatic conservative and pass reforms that are broadly acceptable to the American people. I will return a part of our historic surplus to all of our hard-working families who pay taxes.
zh: 保守主义并不意味着愤怒和分裂。我将作为一个明智、务实的保守派来执政，并通过美国人民广泛接受的改革。我将把我们历史盈余的一部分返还给所有勤劳纳税的家庭。

source: As President, I will work with Republicans and Democrats to advocate for programs that all Americans can approve of. We need to move past the divisiveness of recent years and strengthen our economy, Social Security, education, and Medicare. I would prefer to return some of the budget surplus to the people, but I am willing to compromise to get things done.
zh: 作为总统，我将与共和党和民主党合作，倡导所有美国人都能批准的计划。我们需要克服近年来的分歧，加强我们的经济、社会保障、教育和联邦医疗保险。我宁愿将部分预算盈余返还给人民，但为了完成任务我愿意妥协。

source: We will emphasize that a vote for Al Gore is a vote for the scandals and liberal policies of the Clinton Administration. We offer a true, conservative alternative to the American people. I will discuss my evangelical Christianity and small-government beliefs.
zh: 我们将强调，投票给阿尔·戈尔就是投票给克林顿政府的丑闻和自由主义政策。我们为美国人民提供了一个真正的、保守的选择。我将讨论我的福音派基督教和小政府信仰。

source: It is important to nail down our conservative base by emphasizing tax cuts, my evangelical background, opposition to abortion, a strong defense, and limits to government spending. We will ignore Bill Clinton, but paint Al Gore as out of touch.
zh: 重要的是通过强调减税、我的福音派背景、反对堕胎、强有力的防御和对政府支出的限制来巩固我们的保守派基础。我们将忽略比尔·克林顿，但将阿尔·戈尔描绘为脱离实际。

source: We need to run an attacking campaign against Al Gore. We will expose his misstatements and emphasize that his proposals will squander our budget surplus and greatly increase the size and scope of government.
zh: 我们需要对阿尔·戈尔发起攻击活动。我们将揭露他的错误陈述，并强调他的建议将浪费我们的预算盈余，并大大增加政府的规模和范围。

source: I will campaign as a conciliatory, moderate conservative. I will emphasize my record as the Governor of Texas, and my support across different groups and parties. We will minimize any talk of budget cuts or overturning existing programs. We will resist the temptation to criticize Bill Clinton.
zh: 我将作为一个和解的、温和的保守派参加竞选活动。我将强调我作为得克萨斯州州长的记录，以及我对不同团体和政党的支持。我们将尽量减少任何有关削减预算或推翻现有计划的讨论。我们将抵制批评的诱惑比尔·克林顿。

source: I plead guilty. I don't have experience with the broken political culture of Washington, unlike my opponent. I will clean this system up when I am President.
zh: 我承认。与我的对手不同，我没有在华盛顿那种腐败失灵的政治文化中混迹的经验。当上总统后，我会整顿这个体系。

source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, conservative candidate who will control spending and return our surplus to the American people.
zh: 让我们好好演讲一下，我是如何成为主流保守派候选人的，他将控制支出并将我们的盈余返还给美国人民。

source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to reform Social Security, education, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
zh: 国内问题。让我们谈谈我的改革计划社会保障、教育和联邦医疗保险，以确保美国未来的繁荣。让我们提醒选民，这些都是常识性的提案，几乎对所有人都有吸引力。

source: We need to attack Al Gore's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
zh: 我们需要攻击阿尔·戈尔对环境、能源、税收、支出以及我国正确方向的看法。他与美国人民脱节。

source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Governor of Texas. I will remind voters that I have worked across the aisle, won support from many different groups, and will be a uniter, not a divider, when I arrive in Washington.
zh: 我会强调担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩与经验，提醒选民：我曾跨越党派合作，赢得过许多不同群体的支持。到了华盛顿，我将团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my brother Jeb in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
zh: 我将在佛罗里达州中与我的兄弟 Jeb 一起度过竞选的最后阶段。这种状态对于我们的机会至关重要。

source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can bring into the fold.
zh: 我将出现在宾夕法尼亚州中，并在俄亥俄州中度过后半天。这是我们可以纳入的两个巨大州。

source: The upper Midwest is key. I will start in Iowa, travel through Wisconsin, and end up in Michigan.
zh: 中西部北部是关键。我将从艾奥瓦州开始，经过威斯康星州，最后到达密歇根州。

source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but with one last push we can make them go Republican.
zh: 我们需要关注密苏里州、田纳西州和阿肯色州等状态。克林顿可能在四年前赢得了他们，但只要最后一搏，我们就能让他们成为共和党人。

source: This could destroy my campaign in the final days. We must accuse the Gore campaign of leaking this to discredit my candidacy, and challenge their credibility and timing.
zh: 这可能会在最后几天毁掉我的竞选活动。我们必须指责戈尔竞选团队泄露此信息以抹黑我的候选资格，并挑战他们的可信度和时机。

source: I will admit my guilt and apologize to the American people for hiding this story. I will say it was a mistake in judgment to believe that this would not come to light in our modern media environment.
zh: 我会承认自己有罪，并向美国人民道歉，因为我隐瞒了这个故事。我想说的是，相信这不会在我们的现代媒体环境中曝光，这是一个错误的判断。

source: I will emphasize that I made mistakes in the past that I'm not proud of, and that I've always been up front with the American people about that fact. I will also remind the voters that I have not drank alcohol since 1986, and question why this came out five days before the election.
zh: 我要强调的是，我过去犯过一些我并不感到自豪的错误，而且我一直向美国人民坦白这一事实。我还会提醒选民，我自1986年以来就没有喝酒，并质问为什么在选举前五天发布这一消息。

source: I refuse to comment on this issue. My spokeswoman will remind the American people that the real issue is who will be a better President for the country.
zh: 我拒绝对此问题发表评论。我的发言人将提醒美国人民，真正的问题是谁将成为国家更好的总统。

source: These stories are absolutely false. I never used illegal drugs and those who say I did are completely mistaken.
zh: 这些故事绝对是假的。我从未使用过非法药物，那些说我使用过的人是完全错误的。

source: I did some things when I was younger that I'm not proud of. But my record in office and my conduct over the past two decades is clear. I stopped drinking in 1986 and never looked back.
zh: 我年轻时做了一些我并不自豪的事情。但我的执政记录和过去二十年的行为是清楚的。我从 1986 年开始戒酒，之后就再也没有回头。

source: These types of stories should be irrelevant to a political campaign. We've all done things when we were young that we're not proud of.
zh: 这些类型的故事应该与政治运动无关。年轻的时候，我们都曾做过一些不值得骄傲的事情。

source: This is nonsense. I have served as the Governor of Texas, the second largest state in the country, for nearly six years.
zh: 这是无稽之谈。我担任该国第二大州得克萨斯州的州长已近六年。
